name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION amending the decision of 18 December 2024 on setting up a special committee on the Housing Crisis in the European Union to extend the special committee’s term of office and adjust its responsibilities
part_text:
The European Parliament is extending its special committee on the housing crisis by six months. The committee will keep working on solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing, and will check how the Commission and Member States follow up on Parliament's March 2026 housing resolution. It will also look at issues like short-term holiday rentals, help for people with disabilities, building barriers, and housing funding, and report its conclusions when the extended term ends.

- The housing crisis committee's term is extended by six months, with wider tasks.
- It affects the Commission, Member States, and people facing high housing costs.
- The committee will report its conclusions at the end of its extended term.
